title: An electron deflected by a uniform field
caption: The electron crosses the field at constant speed 2 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹, taking t = 0.05/(2 × 10⁷) = 2.5 ns, while the field accelerates it sideways at a = eE/m = 3.5 × 10¹⁵ m s⁻². Its path is a parabola, y = ½at² ∝ x², and after 5 cm it has moved 1.1 cm sideways.
alt: Graph of sideways deflection against distance travelled: a parabola reaching 1.1 cm at 5 cm.
description: The horizontal axis is the distance travelled through the field in cm; the vertical axis is the sideways deflection in cm.
Constant speed along the field: x = vt. Uniform acceleration across it: a = eE/m = 3.5 × 10¹⁵ m s⁻².
So y = ½a(x/v)², a parabola. At x = 5 cm (t = 2.5 ns) the deflection is 1.1 cm.

checks.name: the path is a parabola: half the distance, a quarter of the deflection
